title: Monolayer geometry relaxation
action: Relax the atomic positions and lattice parameters of isolated blueP, SMoSe, and SWSe monolayers using DFT‑PBE with Grimme D2 van der Waals correction. Compute PBE and HSE06 band gaps to verify the method.
description: Provides relaxed monolayer structures used to build heterostacks. The evidence file records lattice constants, bond lengths, and band gaps, but these are not scored.

title: Heterobilayer construction and relaxation
action: Using the relaxed monolayers, build initial geometries for the four heterobilayers (P‑SeMoS, P‑SMoSe, P‑SeWS, P‑SWSe) by stacking the monolayers in the two chalcogen‑ordering models (SMSe and SeMS) and testing the stacking configurations described in the task. Identify the most stable stacking by binding energy and interlayer distance, then fully relax the optimum structure with DFT‑PBE+D2.
description: Produces the relaxed heterostructures required for band structure and thermal stability calculations. The evidence records the chosen stacking, binding energy, and interlayer spacing.

title: AIMD thermal stability verification
action: Run ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) at 300 K for at least 6 ps on each relaxed heterobilayer to verify that the structures remain thermally stable at room temperature. Confirm that no bond breaking or major structural changes occur during the simulation.
description: Verifies thermal stability of the relaxed heterostructures. The evidence file records the mean and RMSD of key structural parameters over the trajectory, but is not scored.

title: Electronic structure and band alignment analysis
action: For each relaxed and thermally‑stable heterostructure, compute band structures with PBE and HSE06 functionals. Extract the absolute VBM and CBM energies (relative to vacuum). From projected band structures, determine the orbital character at the band edges and the spatial localization (which monolayer) to classify each heterostructure as type‑I or type‑II.
description: Computes the band gaps, absolute band edge energies, and band alignment type. The evidence file stores these raw results per heterostructure.

title: Photocatalytic feasibility evaluation and final report
action: Using the absolute VBM/CBM energies (vacuum‑referenced) obtained in step 04, compare each heterostructure's band edges to the standard water reduction (−4.44 eV) and oxidation (−5.67 eV) potentials at pH 0 vs. vacuum. Determine the water‑splitting suitability: 'overall' if both edges straddle the redox potentials, 'oxidation_only' if only the oxidation potential is satisfied, or 'no' otherwise. Collect all final quantities — band gaps (PBE and HSE06), VBM/CBM energies, VBM and CBM localization (blueP or Janus layer), alignment type (I or II), and water_splitting_type — into a single JSON file.
description: The final scored artifact containing the reproduced headline quantities for all four heterostructures.
output_schema: JSON object with top-level keys 'P‑SeMoS', 'P‑SMoSe', 'P‑SeWS', 'P‑SWSe'. Each value is an object with keys: band_gap_PBE (float, eV), band_gap_HSE06 (float, eV), VBM_energy_vacuum (float, eV), CBM_energy_vacuum (float, eV), VBM_localization (string: 'blueP' or 'SMoSe' or 'SWSe'), CBM_localization (string: 'blueP' or 'SMoSe' or 'SWSe'), alignment_type (string: 'I' or 'II'), water_splitting_type (string: 'overall' | 'oxidation_only' | 'no').
